steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: OCR J198 uses specific command words that determine the depth and type of response required

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Describe' means give an account of what happened — focus on factual detail and chronological order

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Explain' requires giving reasons or causes — show how and why something happened

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: 'Explain the significance/importance' demands you show both what happened and why it mattered

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What is the key difference between 'describe' and 'explain' command words? | Q: What must you include in a 'how far' answer? | Q: How many marks are extended questions typically worth in OCR J198?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Describe requires giving an account of what happened (factual detail), while explain requires giving reasons why it happened (causation and significance). | A balanced argument showing both sides of the issue, supported by specific evidence, leading to a clear judgement about the extent. | 12-15 marks, requiring sustained argument, analysis and a clear judgement.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always circle or underline the command word before you start writing — it determines your entire approach For 'how far' questions, plan both sides before writing so your argument is balanced Short-answer questions: one point per mark is a good rule of thumb Extended answers need 3-4 developed paragraphs plus a conclusion Don't just describe when the question asks you to explain — always link back to reasons and significance
